scope: Complete N3 metadata including startup and final memory/schedule closure; excludes fixture verification, input generation, proof preissue and recursive proof generation.

comparison_method.ordering: Alternate baseline/candidate by repetition and configuration; exclusive sequential processes.
comparison_method.statistic: Median complete-stage seconds; ratio of medians for gates. Retain every sample, range and paired median reduction.

notes: Only the final 140 alternating runs determine performance gates. Diagnostic failures and screens remain in their original receipts.
worker_ns and overlap_worker_ns are summed task wall times, not OS CPU time. gpu_ns spans coordinator source-preparation calls, not precise device busy time.
The case pipeline uses at most 64 outstanding tasks; native tasks carry at most two items. Result memory is charged until coordinator adoption.
Large linear-map numeric plans are held in a bounded phase-local cache. The cache is destroyed after workers join, before its reservation is released.
Descriptor requests include explicit warmups and merged worker hits. Cold compilations and evictions are distinct from native verifier recordings.
Documentation and this evidence were added after the measured source snapshot.
